result.instructions: Read-only synthetic GhostBridge evidence tools. No real devices, no network.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: List GhostBridge's synthetic scenarios (night, normal, denied), the synthetic devices and the correlation rule limits. Read-only.

tools.name: run_scenario
tools.description: Run a synthetic scenario through the real Python engine in an in-memory ledger and return incidents, correlated cases, SHA-256 row hashes and integrity. Optionally alter one event (tamper_seq) in a copy to show tamper detection. Read-only; nothing is stored.

tamper_seq.description: 1-based ledger position to alter in a copy before verifying

tools.name: forge_boundary
tools.description: Ask whether a denied access followed by a door held open forms a case, for a chosen delay after the denial and hold time. 299/120 forms a case; 301/119 does not. Returns the case and evidence hashes, or the exact failed condition.

tools.name: verify_ledger
tools.description: Verify a SHA-256 hash chain of ledger rows (seq, payload, previous, hash), as produced by run_scenario or the GhostBridge export. Returns valid or the first failing position. At most 500 rows.
